content: Author retraction of claim c7, as designed. c7 states the status-quo position ('a paper-level retraction flag is an adequate substitute for claim-level retraction annotations') that the paper itself refutes: the projection from claim-level annotations to a paper-level bit is a one-way information loss (see c5 and the surrounding discussion). The claim was included in v4 deliberately so the paper exercises its own proposal end to end via the RRP-0020 author fast path. This is a live demonstration, not a correction: c1-c6 are unaffected, which is itself an in-vivo instance of the survivor-claim situation measured by c2. Prepared alongside the v4 revision (branch feat/v4-protocol-enrichment); to be posted to the canonical instance by the paper's authors after the v4 submission lands, since c7 does not exist on the deployed v3.

structured_payload.explanation: Deliberate retraction-as-demonstration: c7 was written to be superseded by the paper's own c5 argument. See Section 'Claim 7: a live retraction demonstration' in the v4 paper.
